profile.headline: Software Developer at USAA
profile.summary: Software Developer and Engineer with 7+ years of experience providing technical design and project management support as a resource to the business across multiple systems and complex features. Expertise with solving complex technical issues independently. Growth minded learner, professionally known for sound technical judgement, continuous skill improvement and contributions to new engineer development through volunteer coaching, mentoring, and tutoring.

positions.title: Software Developer II / System Design Engineer II
positions.description:
Worked on Rackspace’s Global Infrastructure Engineering team (responsible for evaluating and exploring new hardware technologies while under NDA, and provided the highest level of engineering support, often by working with vendors). Experience working with dev-ops, product design, and process engineer teams utilizing lean/agile process. Served as main engineer to manage the full cycle of the following projects, including gathering requirements, defining use cases, project plan development, implementation, support, delegation, and documentation of process.

Automated System Testing
* Created, automated, and maintained a system to run a wide range of hardware benchmarking tools and provide unified interface for viewing and analyzing results
* Automated process for running server benchmarks using Bash, formatted results using Perl, saved them to central location, and built web interface that displays and compare results using Java and Spring

Fleet Inventory Monitoring
* Designed a Fleet Inventory Monitoring and Tracking system for Dell and HP systems in coordination with process engineering team members to leverage internal tools to provide data that enabled proactive maintenance
* Integrated Dell's IDRAC though custom VBS scripts added to ARIC, and leveraged HP's REST API, storing results in MongoDB and Splunk
* Studied and analyzed the results of over 100k systems in Splunk to track part locations, out of date systems, identify potential issues, generate reports for other teams


Drive Wipe Process
* Redesigned Rackspace's drive wiping system, while ensuring it would continue to work with the existing process but still had the capability to easily adapt to any new process
* Worked on changes to the core wiping program, an open source project named NWipe
* Built Rest API to allow internal tools to gather results from old wipe servers and integrate them with the Fleet Inventory results
* Received company’s Dragon Slayer Award for cost savings from drive reuse

positions.title: Application Development Intern II
positions.description: Worked on Several projects for Supply Chain, including: Complete Automation of Sever Evaluation Tests, a power monitoring program that uses serial communications with multiple power monitoring devices, and other small projects.

positions.title: Intern II - Application Development
positions.description:
• Performed multi-tiered application development using J2EE standards (HTML, JavaScript, JSP, Java Servlets, JavaBeans, JDBC) and Open Source technology.
• Responsible for gathering system requirements, defining use cases, business rules and developing project plans.
• Member of a development team responsible for the development of “Foundation Service Driver (FSD)” a dynamic User Interface(UI) generator to test any restful web services, when given its configuration files.

positions.title: PREP Mentor (Program Assistant)
positions.description:
•Supervised approximately 20 students grades 5-6
•Tutored students in Logic, Algebra, Electrical Engineering, Physics 
•Graded papers for Instructors
